title: You Don't Need Python to Keep Up With AI
description:
Just want to keep up with AI and not fall behind, without building anything specific? Honest answer: you don't need Python at all. Coding only matters if you'll use it professionally or for a real project. 

Instead, focus on the skills that actually move the needle for you: prompting AI models better, getting good output, spotting bad output, and understanding the advanced features inside these tools. 

Learning Cursor or Claude Code will do far more for you than learning Python theory.

#techwithtim #ai #learntocode
